name: nfc-tag-studio
description: NFC Tag Studio - desktop app to read, edit, back up and batch-issue the NFC tags your organization manages (NTAG213/215/216, MIFARE Classic with your own keys, FeliCa Lite-S).
author: UnlitCube

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.e2e: npm run build && tsc -p tests/e2e/tsconfig.json && playwright test
scripts.hw:write: npm run build && tsc -p tests/e2e/tsconfig.json && playwright test -c playwright.hw.config.ts
scripts.shots: npm run build && tsc -p tests/e2e/tsconfig.json && playwright test -c playwright.shots.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run unit && npm run test:smoke
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run notices:check && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.json
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && npm run notices:check && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.json
